principles: Pre-2006 ratings describe current Serbia territory inside Yugoslav/Serbia-and-Montenegro governance and do not inherit predecessor-state population, participation or outcomes wholesale.
FSS lineage and state transitions are chronology context, not direct annual quality measurements.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is used only from 2006 onward for participation/access context.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is used only from 2023 onward for professional-ecosystem context.
No ranking or title outcome is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains reserved for world-leading dimensions.
